title: The mass gap over the compact simple groups
description: A manuscript deriving a mass gap for lattice gauge theory over every compact simple group, constructively over the positive naturals, together with its Lean 4 formalization: two libraries, MassGap and MassGapChecks, Lean core alone, every declaration at the empty axiom set and every check module decided by the kernel. The README states which clauses of the main theorem the Lean tree holds at this version and which remain open; the release is not a completed formal proof of the Yang-Mills mass gap.
